capability_profile.assurance: numerical binary64; this report does not establish validated arithmetic or broader scalability
capability_profile.supported_case: one-step scalar linear dynamics, bounded interval control/guard, deterministic scalar affine reset, linear objective

environment.timing_scope: Setup constructs the fixture and registered providers; assembly builds the complete path portfolio and H relation; solve executes the registered branch optimizer; verify rebuilds the candidate face and checks the complete path family; end-to-end begins before fixture construction and ends after verification. CSV/JSONL output, rendering and build are excluded.
environment.warmup_policy: One excluded 10-call batch followed by seven measured 20-call batches
environment.workspace_reuse: none; fresh registered provider/workspace per call

evidence_limits: One host, one Release configuration, one fixture, and a numerical binary64 verifier.
Process CPU values sum all process threads during the branch interval; concurrent unrelated process work may contribute and values are not provider-only CPU.
Provider invocation records use a narrower synchronous wall/CPU interval; process CPU still sums all process threads, includes clock sampling, and may include unrelated work.
Per-operation CPU measures only the synchronous composing thread and excludes CPU consumed by helper threads.
Provider memory use is unmeasured; the HiGHS adapter refuses finite memory requests rather than claiming enforcement.
No comparator, speedup, source-mapped bottleneck, application-scale result, or general scalability claim.
The supported verifier domain is one-step scalar interval systems; continuous multi-stage verification is outside this report.
evidence_scope: 140 successful measured public hybrid portfolio calls over one fixed analytic one-step scalar fixture; each call constructs the path H relation, solves the branch with HiGHS LP and independently verifies its complete interval minimizer family

measurement.comparison: single adapter; descriptive measurements only; no comparator or speedup claim

operation_thread_cpu.scope: CPU consumed by the synchronous composing thread during each relation operation

process_cpu.attribution: process-scoped, not provider-only; unrelated concurrent process work may contribute
process_cpu.scope: process CPU accumulated across all threads during workspace creation and branch execution

provider_invocation.scope: synchronous provider invocation; process CPU includes clock sampling and may include helper threads or unrelated concurrent process work
